page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Right margin is blank. Left margin holds one marginal note, "Cap.17.", beside the line "cit libro de Re medica quarto". Running head at top with page number 246.

main_text.p: in profundo permoleftus sentitur, tendiq; omnino & contendi membrum apparet, cum uehementi incendio,renitentia & ru-bore. Quae sane palsio totius generis no-men recipit, inflammatioq; uocatur ex o-mni fere occasione proueniens. Et libro, Methodi medendi,decimoquarto,idem o-stendit sic erysipelas a phlegmone discernens. Haud lōge abest (inquit) a phlegmone alius morbus erysipelas dictus: qui quidem ex succo biliofo ortus,tumorem calo-remq; cum illa fortitur communem. Difsi-dent inter se tamen affectus ij primum maximeq; colore. Quandoquidem si is ruber sit uitiu uocatur phlegmone. Sin pallidus, flauusue,uel ex pallido,flauoq; colore mi-stus,erysipelas. Deinde ex ceteris alijs,tum Graecis, tum Latinis, qui in hoc consenti-unt,unius (causa compendij) nempe Pauli Aeginetae testimonii duntaxat producam. Sic enim de his symptomatis, quae inflammationem semper consequuntur uerba fa-Cap.17.cit libro de Re medica quarto.Proinde (in-quit) ab ea,quae priuatim inflammatio ap-pellatur initium fumemus, quae in multis faepe contingit,quę tumor est rubicundus, dolorosus,renitens & calidus,ex sanguino bono[?]

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Line-end words "bono" at the bottom right is partly cut off and slightly unclear; marked [?]. "fi is ruber" read as "si is ruber" (long s). Line-end "remq;" follows "calo-" and is read as printed. Running head reads "ABDITAS" as printed. Hyphens at line ends kept as printed.
